body.name: corrected local moments
body.construction: Put \(h=h_n\), \(w_i=h^{-d}\mathbf 1\{X_i\in h[0,1]^d\}\), \(v_i=v(X_i/h)\mathbf 1\{X_i\in h[0,1]^d\}\), and \(b_i=b_{M_n}(X_i/h)\mathbf 1\{X_i\in h[0,1]^d\}\), with every zero-indicator product evaluated before an outside-domain basis value. Define \[\widetilde Q_n=\frac1n\sum_iw_iv_iA_i(A_i-3/8)v_i^{\mathsf T}-\frac1{n(n-1)}\sum_{i\ne j}w_iw_jv_i(A_i-3/8)(b_i^{\mathsf T}b_j)A_jv_j^{\mathsf T},\] \[\widetilde R_n=\frac1n\sum_iw_iv_i(Y_i-1/2)(A_i-3/8)-\frac1{n(n-1)}\sum_{i\ne j}w_iw_jv_i(A_i-3/8)(b_i^{\mathsf T}b_j)(Y_j-1/2).\]
